summary: This clinical trial compares two different drugs, semaglutide and metformin, to see how they affect weight loss in women with Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS). Polycystic Ovary Syndrome is a hormonal condition that can affect a woman's health and weight. The study plans to enroll 60 participants who will take either metformin by mouth or semaglutide by injection. University of Hull is sponsoring this Phase 2/3 study, which has an unknown status.
